import struct,zlib
d=open('spec.png','rb').read()
p=8;idat=b''
while p<len(d):
    l,t=struct.unpack('>I4s',d[p:p+8]);c=d[p+8:p+8+l]
    if t==b'IHDR':print(struct.unpack('>IIBBBBB',c))
    if t==b'PLTE':print('plte',c)
    if t==b'IDAT':idat+=c
    p+=12+l
print(len(zlib.decompress(idat)))
"
